[ASSISTANT_SAID] Fresh herbs can elevate cocktails to a whole new level.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested unique cocktail recipes incorporating fresh herbs, including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Cucumber-Basil Gimlet: Muddle fresh basil leaves with lime juice, simple syrup, and cucumber slices; add gin, shake, strain, and garnish with a basil leaf and cucumber slice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Rosemary Gin Fizz: Infuse gin with rosemary, mix with lemon juice, simple syrup, and soda water; garnish with rosemary sprig and lemon twist.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Mint to Be: Combine bourbon, fresh mint leaves, lime juice, and honey syrup; shake, strain, and serve with mint sprig and lime wheel.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Sage Advice: Muddle fresh sage leaves with bourbon, apple cider, and lemon juice; strain into rocks glass with ice and top with sage leaf.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Thyme for a Collins: Mix gin, lemon juice, simple syrup, and thyme; strain into Collins glass with ice and top with soda water; garnish with thyme sprig and lemon wheel.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Lavender Dream: Combine gin, lavender syrup, lemon juice, and soda water; strain into coupe and garnish with dried lavender bud.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Cilantro-Lime Margarita: Blend tequila, lime juice, agave syrup, and fresh cilantro; strain into salt-rimmed glass and garnish with lime wheel and cilantro sprig.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Parsley-Grapefruit Spritz: Mix prosecco, grapefruit juice, and parsley syrup; garnish with parsley sprig and grapefruit slice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Dill-icious Mule: Combine vodka, ginger beer, lime juice, and fresh dill; garnish with lime wheel and dill sprig.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Chive-Cherry Sour: Shake bourbon, cherry liqueur, lemon juice, and chive leaves; strain into rocks glass and garnish with cherry and chive sprig.  
[PREFERENCE] User is particularly interested in the Cucumber-Basil Gimlet.
